name: Actuarial Signal Investigation

building_blocks.purpose: Queue an immutable signal handoff, coordinate investigation, return review-required output
Retrieve checksummed methodology caveats and relevant case evidence
Use the team-configured AMD/vLLM open model for evidence-aware investigation

steps.name: Receive signal
steps.input: multipart input = JSON handoff from the application

steps.name: Validate signal
steps.contract: Validate signal_package with the canonical schema; copy required_signal_snapshot; reject invalid input

steps.name: Retrieve methodology
steps.owner: Evolus Knowledge Library attached to investigation agent
steps.contract: Retrieve only registered curated chunks relevant to this case; retain chunk IDs and hashes; no raw datasets

steps.name: Investigate
steps.owner: Evolus agent using configured team AMD/vLLM endpoint
steps.contract: Use system instructions and investigation_response schema; no detection decisions

steps.name: Validate response
steps.contract: Schema, immutable snapshot, registered references, model metadata, causal-language review; keep original text

steps.name: Require human review
steps.contract: HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED on every branch; failures must not close incidents

steps.name: Return report
steps.contract: Return investigation, knowledge_citations, model_execution; application preserves audit and writes English/Spanish report

manual_requirements: Create event workspace and API key
Create Knowledge Library and upload/index curated excerpts
Add/test team AMD/vLLM endpoint and choose it in agent
Create workflow steps and language parameter; attach library; enable workflow
Inspect Completed execution shape and set EVOLUS_RESULT_POINTER; retain native export/run logs
